answer_sql:
WITH g AS (
  SELECT
    l.order_date,
    l.net_amount
  FROM contoso_served.v_contoso5_sales_line AS l
  JOIN contoso_served.dim_customer AS cu
    ON l.customer_key = cu.customer_key
  JOIN contoso_served.dim_country AS c
    ON cu.country_code = c.country_code
  WHERE
    c.country_name = 'Germany'
    AND l.channel = 'online'
    AND l.order_date >= CAST('2024-01-01' AS DATE)
    AND l.order_date < CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE)
)
SELECT
  STRFTIME(order_date, '%Y-%m') AS month,
  ROUND(SUM(net_amount), 2) AS revenue
FROM g
GROUP BY
  1
ORDER BY
  month ASC

sections.title: What it says its rows are

body.value: Twelve rows, one per calendar month of 2024, each the money customers resident in Germany actually paid Contoso's web shop — after discount, in US dollars — for orders they placed in that month. The year comes to 2,428,570.52 USD (the twelve rounded figures add to 2,428,570.54; the two cents are per-month rounding). The trend: January and February strong at 278,799.15 and 276,613.40, a sharp slump to 124,514.27 in March and 100,946.49 in April, the year's trough at 96,103.50 in July, then recovery through August to a November peak of 282,082.99, easing to 203,972.56 in December. NOT INCLUDED: physical-shop sales (German shops took a further 1,540,736.67 in 2024); customers living outside Germany, whatever shop they used; orders placed outside 2024 even if delivered inside it; gross revenue — these are net, with gross running 6–8% higher each month; any conversion to euros, the amounts being USD as stored; and any month-over-month change column, which was not asked for.

The 2,905 sales lines meeting all three restrictions together: the CUSTOMER's registered country is Germany (dim_customer.country_code = 'DE', matched by name through dim_country) — not the shop's country, which for this channel is the '--' sentinel and yields zero rows; the sale came through channel = 'online', which here is the one outlet store_key 999999 'Online store' (every German online line also satisfies the declared location_code = -1 test, so "the one named shop" and "the online channel" are identical rows); and order_date lies in calendar 2024, read on order_date not delivery_date. Grouped into twelve exhaustive, disjoint months, all occupied with 20–28 trading days each, so no row is padded and no dip is a coverage artefact. The figure is SUM(net_amount) — net of discount, in USD.

WITH de AS (
  SELECT
    country_code
  FROM contoso_served.dim_country
  WHERE
    country_name ILIKE '%german%'
), base AS (
  SELECT
    l.net_amount,
    l.channel,
    ds.country_code AS store_cc,
    cu.country_code AS cust_cc,
    dl.country_code AS loc_cc
  FROM contoso_served.v_contoso5_sales_line AS l
  LEFT JOIN contoso_served.dim_store AS ds
    ON l.store_key = ds.store_key
  LEFT JOIN contoso_served.dim_customer AS cu
    ON l.customer_key = cu.customer_key
  LEFT JOIN contoso_served.dim_location AS dl
    ON ds.location_code = dl.location_code
  WHERE
    l.order_date >= CAST('2024-01-01' AS DATE)
    AND l.order_date < CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE)
)
SELECT
  channel,
  COUNT(*) AS lines_in_channel,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN store_cc IN (
    SELECT
      country_code
    FROM de
  ) THEN 1 END) AS lines_store_de,
  ROUND(
    SUM(
      CASE
        WHEN store_cc IN (
          SELECT
            country_code
          FROM de
        )
        THEN net_amount
        ELSE 0
      END
    ),
    2
  ) AS revenue_store_de,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN cust_cc IN (
    SELECT
      country_code
    FROM de
  ) THEN 1 END) AS lines_customer_de,
  ROUND(
    SUM(
      CASE
        WHEN cust_cc IN (
          SELECT
            country_code
          FROM de
        )
        THEN net_amount
        ELSE 0
      END
    ),
    2
  ) AS revenue_customer_de,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN loc_cc IN (
    SELECT
      country_code
    FROM de
  ) THEN 1 END) AS lines_location_de,
  ROUND(
    SUM(
      CASE
        WHEN loc_cc IN (
          SELECT
            country_code
          FROM de
        )
        THEN net_amount
        ELSE 0
      END
    ),
    2
  ) AS revenue_location_de
FROM base
GROUP BY
  channel
ORDER BY
  channel

The three readings agree exactly on physical sales (1,812 lines, 1,540,736.67 all three ways) and only the customer path yields anything online (2,905 lines, 2,428,570.52), so I apply it, disclose it, and do not ask — the choice is between a figure and an empty result, not between two rival figures. This move confirms Germany's code is single (the relation notes one duplicate spelling among nine) and fixes step 2's population.

SELECT

    FROM de

GROUP BY
  l.channel
ORDER BY
  l.channel

SELECT

  ds.store_name,

WITH g AS (
  SELECT
    l.order_date,
    l.delivery_date,
    l.net_amount
  FROM contoso_served.v_contoso5_sales_line AS l
  JOIN contoso_served.dim_customer AS cu
    ON l.customer_key = cu.customer_key
  JOIN contoso_served.dim_country AS c
    ON cu.country_code = c.country_code
  WHERE
    c.country_name = 'Germany' AND l.channel = 'online'
)
SELECT
  COUNT(
    CASE
      WHEN order_date >= CAST('2024-01-01' AS DATE)
      AND order_date < CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE)
      THEN 1
    END
  ) AS lines_by_order_date,
  ROUND(
    SUM(
      CASE
        WHEN order_date >= CAST('2024-01-01' AS DATE)
        AND order_date < CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE)
        THEN net_amount
        ELSE 0
      END
    ),
    2
  ) AS revenue_by_order_date,
  COUNT(
    DISTINCT CASE
      WHEN order_date >= CAST('2024-01-01' AS DATE)
      AND order_date < CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE)
      THEN DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', order_date)
    END
  ) AS months_with_orders,
  MIN(
    CASE
      WHEN order_date >= CAST('2024-01-01' AS DATE)
      AND order_date < CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE)
      THEN order_date
    END
  ) AS first_order_2024,
  MAX(
    CASE
      WHEN order_date >= CAST('2024-01-01' AS DATE)
      AND order_date < CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE)
      THEN order_date
    END
  ) AS last_order_2024,
  COUNT(
    CASE
      WHEN delivery_date >= CAST('2024-01-01' AS DATE)
      AND delivery_date < CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE)
      THEN 1
    END
  ) AS lines_by_delivery_date,
  ROUND(
    SUM(
      CASE
        WHEN delivery_date >= CAST('2024-01-01' AS DATE)
        AND delivery_date < CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE)
        THEN net_amount
        ELSE 0
      END
    ),
    2
  ) AS revenue_by_delivery_date
FROM g
